name: Biotransference
oracle_text:
Creatures you control are artifacts in addition to their other types. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token.

needs.what: a 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature token (no abilities)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Necron Warrior; the nearest 2/2 black tokens (astartes_warrior_2_2_b_menace, zombie_2_2_b, rogue_2_2_b) have the wrong creature types, lack the Artifact card type, or carry menace. The rest of the card is expressible: the first line is an add_subtype static with types ["Artifact"], affects {controller: you, types: [Creature]} and off_battlefield: true (the Maskwood Nexus spelling), and the trigger is spell_cast filtered to artifact spells with lose_life 1 plus create_token
